DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！ごきげんようですの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度、海へ遊びに行くことになりまして！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それも……百花繚乱の先輩方と一緒に！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: おぉ、いいね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ！まるで夢のようですわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 素敵な時間を満喫するために……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 琵琶の特訓をいたします！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……琵琶？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 海に行くんだよね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もしや、舞のほうがふさわしいでしょうか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ご相談に伺いますわね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今から？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今すぐ参りますわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本日の水着、大切にしまっておきますの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 着るときはちゃんと着なきゃね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もちろんですわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 物の価値は、使われてこそ輝きを増すものですから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 身共はお布団に入りながら考えました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ここ数日、考えに考え抜きました！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海にあって、百花繚乱の名に恥じない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 華麗な姿を披露するにはどうすればよいか！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: その心は？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 海での「華麗な姿」とは？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それはすなわち！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 水中を自由に舞い踊る魚たちのような

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 見事な泳ぎですの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: たしかにそれは華麗だね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: たしかにそれは名案だね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これから水泳の猛練習に励む予定ですの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そこで、先生にお願いがありまして

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: よろしければ身共に水泳の極意を教えていただけませんか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんな大それた技術はないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いいよ、一緒に練習しよっか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は家の者が失礼いたしました……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 身共のこととなると、つい過保護になってしまうようでして

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ユカリのことを大事に思ってるんだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私のことは気にしなくて大丈夫だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: せっかく、先生のお時間をいただいて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 水泳の練習ができると思いましたのに……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 次回に持ち越しだね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 次は海で練習するんだよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ！約束ですの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今からとっても楽しみにしておりますわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は待ちに待った……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海に行く日ですの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: お、元気だね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 張り切ってるね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ！今度こそたくさん泳ぎますの！しょんぼりしてたらもったいないですから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時は金なり！ですから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ユカリらしい考え方だね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ポジティブだね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: では先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海でお会いいたしましょう！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はたくさん泳げました！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今すぐにでも寝られそうですの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 泳ぐの上手だったよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 優雅で気品あふれる泳ぎだった！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 身共の泳ぎなんて、まだまだですの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: このていどではえりーととはなのれ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ユカリ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 寝ちゃったかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: おやすみ、ユカリ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先ほどは、ついうとうとしてしまいましたの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 会話の途中で、失礼いたしました

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: よく眠れた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 気にしなくていいよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ！おかげさまで！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もうひと泳ぎできそうなくらいですわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 夜の海は危ないから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: また明日遊ぼうね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今晩はまだ眠れそうにありませんの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 海がこんなにも楽しい場所だなんて、身共、初めて知りました！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生を一日中ひとり占めしてしまいましたわ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本日はとっても楽しかったですの！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それはよかった！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私も楽しかったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 身共は、この夏を絶対に

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 絶っっっっ対に！忘れませんわ！！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다름이 아니라, 무려 이번에 바다에 놀러 가기로 되었사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 함께 산 수영복은 제대로 보관해 두었사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 물론, 알고 있사와요! 물건의 가치는 쓰임에서 나오는 것!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 귀엽고 아까운 옷도…… 제대로 입어주지 않으면 만들어 주신 직공분들께 실례겠지요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지난 며칠, 이 소녀, 저녁잠을 지새우며 생각하고, 또 생각했사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 백화요란의 초신성, 미래…… 아니, 초미래라고 불리는 최고의 엘리~트인 소녀이기에…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 반드시 바다에서도 멋진 모습을 보여줘야 한다고 말이어요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 바다에서 보여줄 수 있는 멋진 모습……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런고로 소녀는 오늘부터 수영 맹훈련에 돌입하기로 하여…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 거기서 선생님께 한 가지 부탁이 있사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 괜찮으시다면 소녀에게 수영의 비결을 전수해 주실 수 있을까요?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 평소에는 그런 분들이 아니신데, 소녀와 관련되면 과보호가 되셔서…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 모처럼 오붓하게 선생님과 둘이서 시간을 보내려 했는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 네! 시간은 유한한데, 풀 죽어 있으면 아깝사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 너무 신나게 놀아서 벌써 눈이 감길 지경이어요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그리고 평범한 수준으로는 백화요란의 총애받는 엘리~트를 자칭할 수 없사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 네! 푹 잔 덕분에 완전히 리~커버리한 것이에요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 밤은 아직 잠이 오질 않사와요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 바다가 이렇게 즐거운 장소인지, 소녀, 처음 알았사와요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 저 유카리, 나이는 어릴지언정, 이거 하나만은 자신 있게 말씀드릴 수 있사와요.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Greetings, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The situation is...I am travelling to the sea for leisure!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In addition, it will be with my upperclassmen from the Hyakkaryouran!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's great!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! Perhaps this is simply a dream I am adrift in!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And so that we may have a successful summer vacation...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I must begin practicing gaku-biwa immediately!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...Gaku-biwa?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What does a traditional instrument have to do with vacation?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Should I instead practice my dance skills in preparation?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Let us discuss this in person! Sensei!!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Uh, right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm starting to see a pattern here...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! I am already on my way!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have stored the swimsuit we purchased today in a safe place!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's meant for you to wear!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I understand! Of course, things must be allowed to fulfill their purpose to have true value!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This outfit is so cute and precious! It would be an affront to the seamstress to not wear it as intended!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Over the past few days, I have been tossing and turning through the night, thinking and thinking and thinking!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: As the rising star of the Hyakkaryouran and its future—its brilliant future—this elite girl

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: must reveal an incredible side of herself while at sea!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's come over you all of a sudden?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What does that mean exactly?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, you see, the incredible sea version of me!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Will be!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Good at swimming!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The result of many sleepless nights of thinking...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I had similar thoughts in elementary school!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! In order to achieve this, I must begin my intensive training course! Today!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And I have a request of you, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Could you please bequeath the secret techniques of the art of swimming upon me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: There's nothing special like that, but if you want...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Do you want to meet right now?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! Please!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. My apologies for my household staff...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It was a divergence from their usual manners... They become overprotective when I am involved...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's how they show that they care, Yukari.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's okay! How are you feeling, Yukari?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I am feeling a bit...! MMMmmm!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have lost what would have been a wonderful opportunity to spend quality time with you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: We'll go swimming next time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: We'll be safe together in the ocean!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Fufu! It's a promise!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I shall eagerly await that day!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei! Have you looked outside?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It is the sea!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh, you're back to yourself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're energetic today!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! We only have so much time, so we cannot waste it feeling down!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Time is gold, as they say!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A very Yukari-like approach!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: How positive!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: As you promised, we must swim together in the ocean!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei! I had so much fun!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So much so that I can barely keep my eyelids open!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're a really good swimmer!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That was some very elegant swimming.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Huh? No! I'm only average!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can hardly call myself a Hyakkaryouran elite by simply being average!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll be rooting for you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're always full of energy, Yukari.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Good night.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei... I fell asleep.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: How rude of me...in the middle of conversation...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Did you sleep well?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: As long as you're well rested!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes! I have made a complete recovery!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In fact, I could venture back into the ocean right now!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You shouldn't. It's dangerous to go into the water at night.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Rest tonight, so we can have more fun tomorrow!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But I simply cannot bring myself to sleep tonight!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My experiences in the ocean were both new and exciting!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I had so much fun today!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm glad to hear it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I had fun too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I, Yukari, may be young, but I know one thing with absolute certainty!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That I will neeeeever!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Eeeever! Forget about this summer!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้เป็นยังไงบ้างเจ้าคะ? ท่านอาจารย์!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้าจะมาบอกว่า ข้าจะไปเที่ยวทะเลน่ะ
เจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไปกับพวกรุ่นพี่ในเฮียกกะเรียวรันด้วย
เจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ดีเลยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เจ้าค่ะ! รู้สึกเหมือนฝันไปเลยละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพื่อให้เป็นการพักร้อนที่ยอดเยี่ยม...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตั้งแต่วันนี้ข้าก็เลยจะฝึกเล่นบิวะเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พิณบิวะน่ะเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมถึงจะเล่นพิณขึ้นมาล่ะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หรือว่าข้าไปฝึกระบำดีกว่าเจ้าคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ท่านอาจารย์! ขอข้าแวะไปปรึกษาอะไร
ด้วยหน่อยนะเจ้าคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หืม? ตอนนี้เลยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูชักจะชินกับแพทเทิร์นนี้แล้วสิ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เจ้าค่ะ! ข้าจะไปตอนนี้เลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ท่านอาจารย์!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้าจะเก็บชุดว่ายน้ำที่ซื้อด้วยกันวันนี้
ให้ดีเลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แต่ถึงเวลาก็ต้องเอามาใส่นะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้ารู้ดีเจ้าค่ะ! คุณค่าของสิ่งของอยู่ที่
การใช้งาน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ชุดที่น่ารักพวกนี้ก็ด้วย... ถ้าไม่ใส่ก็จะ
เป็นการเสียมารยาทต่อช่างที่ตัดชุดเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ท่านอาจารย์!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
2-3 วันมานี้ข้าได้แต่นอนคิดแล้วคิดอีก
เจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้าเป็นถึงสุดยอดอิล~ลีทที่จะได้ฉายา
ว่าเป็นอนาคตใหม่ของเฮียกกะเรียวรัน...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะงั้นข้าก็ต้องโชว์ฝีมือในทะเลด้วย
เจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จู่ๆ ก็เริ่มอะไรอีกแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะโชว์ฝีมืออะไรในทะเลเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สิ่งที่ข้าแสดงให้เห็นได้ในทะเล...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็คือ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: การว่ายน้ำเก่งๆ เจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: คิดมาหนักเลยสินะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูเคยคิดแบบนี้สมัยประถมนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตั้งแต่วันนี้ข้าก็เลยจะฝึกว่ายน้ำอย่าง
เอาจริงเอาจัง...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ข้ามีเรื่องอยากขอร้องท่านอาจารย์
อย่างหนึ่งเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ท่านอาจารย์ช่วยสอนเคล็ดลับการ
ว่ายน้ำให้ข้าหน่อยได้มั้ยเจ้าคะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูไม่ได้มีเทคนิคพิเศษมากมาย
หรอกนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: งั้นมาเจอกันเลยมั้ยล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เจ้าค่ะ! ดีเลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ท่านอาจารย์ วันนี้คนในตระกูลข้า
เสียมารยาทไปเจ้าค่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ปกติพวกท่านไม่ได้เป็นคนแบบนั้น
แต่พอเป็นเรื่องเกี่ยวกับข้าก็เป็นห่วงกัน
มากเกินไป...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทุกคนทำเพื่อยูคารินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูไม่ว่าอะไรหรอก แล้วยูคาริล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ข้าเสียดายนิดหน่อยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้าอยากใช้เวลากับท่านอาจารย์แค่
2 คนแท้ๆ เชียว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ไปว่ายน้ำกันทีหลังนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
คนที่บ้านคงไม่ตามมาถึงทะเล
หรอกเนอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ! สัญญาแล้วนะเจ้าคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วข้าจะนับนิ้วรอวันนั้นเลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ท่านอาจารย์!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ท่านอาจารย์! มองเห็นข้างนอกมั้ย
เจ้าคะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทะเลเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โอ้ กลับมามีพลังแล้วสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้มีชีวิตชีวาจังเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เจ้าค่ะ! เวลามีจำกัด ข้าจะมัวหงอยอยู่
ไม่ได้เจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เวลาเป็นเงินเป็นทองนะเจ้าคะ~!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สมกับเป็นยูคาริจังเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: คิดบวกมากเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้น ท่านอาจารย์!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มาว่ายน้ำในทะเลกับข้าตามสัญญานะ
เจ้าคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ท่านอาจารย์! วันนี้สนุกมากเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้าเล่นสนุกมากจนตอนนี้ตาจะปิดแล้ว
เจ้าค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ยูคาริว่ายน้ำเก่งเลยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำได้ยอดเยี่ยมเลยละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เจ้าคะ? แต่ข้าว่ามันธรรมดาๆ นะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ว่ายธรรมดาๆ แบบนั้นจะเรียกว่าเป็น
อิล~ลีทที่น่ารักของเฮียกกะเรียวรัน
ไม่ได้หรอกเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะคอยเชียร์นะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ก็มีชีวิตชีวาดีจัง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ฝันดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ท่านอาจารย์... ข้าเผลอหลับไปเจ้าค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
กำลังคุยกันแท้ๆ แต่ข้าดันเสียมารยาท
ไปจนได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หลับสบายหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เป็นไรเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เจ้าค่ะ! พอได้นอนเต็มอิ่ม ก็เหมือนได้
รีคาบารี~ เต็มที่เลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แบบนี้ข้ามีแรงไปทะเลอีกรอบแล้วเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทะเลตอนกลางคืนมันอันตรายนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้พักผ่อนก่อนแล้วค่อยไปเล่น
พรุ่งนี้เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คืนนี้ข้ายังนอนไม่หลับน่ะเจ้าค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ข้าเพิ่งรู้เลยน่ะเจ้าค่ะ ว่าทะเลเป็นที่ที่
สนุกได้ขนาดนี้!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ท่านอาจารย์!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ข้าสนุกมากเลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูดีใจที่ยูคาริสนุกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูก็สนุกเหมือนกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงข้าจะยังอายุน้อย แต่ข้าก็พูดสิ่งนี้ได้
อย่างเต็มปากเจ้าค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ข้าจะไม่ลืม~!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฤดูร้อนนี้~~~! เด็ดขาดเลยเจ้าค่ะ!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 貴安！老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實我要去海邊玩了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 而且還是和百花繚亂的前輩們一起！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 太好了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是的！簡直像是在做夢一樣！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為了成功度過完美的夏日度假……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我打算從今天開始進行樂琵琶特訓！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……樂琵琶？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 為什麼要練習傳統樂器……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還是應該練舞比較好呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！我馬上去找您商量！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 咦，現在？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這種模式……我也開始習慣了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是的！我現在就去！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天一起買的泳裝，我已經好好收起來了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 該穿的時候一定要拿出來穿哦！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 當然！物品就是要使用才能發揮價值！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這件可愛又珍貴的衣服，如果不拿出來穿……對製作它的工匠們可是很失禮的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 小女子這幾天日夜思考、反覆琢磨！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 身為百花繚亂的新星，未來……不，應該說是超未來的最強菁英……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 小女子在海邊也必須展現出帥氣的模樣！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真是突如其來呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 海邊的帥氣模樣指的是？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 在海邊能展現的帥氣模樣……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那就是！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 高超的泳技！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 想得挺認真的呢……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我小學時期也有類似的想法！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，小女子決定從今天開始進行游泳特訓……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因此有件事想拜託老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果可以的話，能請您傳授游泳的祕訣嗎！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 雖然也沒什麼高深的技巧……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 現在就見面嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是的！拜託了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，今天家人真是失禮了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 他們平常明明不會這樣的，但只要遇到跟小女子有關的事情就會變得過度保護……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 他們也是在為你著想哦，紫

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我不介意，話說紫還好嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 小女子覺得……有點悶悶的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 難得想和老師兩人獨處的說

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 游泳就留到下次吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 他們應該不會跟到海邊來吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵！那我們約好囉！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 小女子會等待那天到來的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！您有看見外面嗎！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是大海！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 哦，恢復精神了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 今天很有幹勁呢！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是的！時間有限，垂頭喪氣實在太浪費了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 時間就是金錢～！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 真像紫的風格！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 超正面！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 按照約定，在海邊要陪我游泳哦！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！今天真的好開心！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 玩得太盡興，眼皮都快撐不住了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 你游得超好耶！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 游姿超優雅的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 咦？小女子覺得只是普通水準……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這樣還無法自稱是百花繚亂的菁～英！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我會為你加油的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 紫真有幹勁

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 晚安

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師……我剛才不小心睡著了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 明明還在聊天，居然這麼失禮……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 睡得好嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒關係！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是的！睡了一覺之後完全恢復了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 甚至要再去海邊都沒問題！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 夜晚的海很危險

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 今天就先休息，明天再玩吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今晚還睡不著呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 小女子第一次知道，海邊竟然是這麼快樂的地方！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天真的非常開心！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 太好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我也很開心

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 小女子雖然年紀還小，但有一件事可以有自信地告訴您

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這個夏天，小女子絕～對！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 絕～～對！不會忘記的！
